claim_boundary.research_question: Does the native one-minute path add forecast and portfolio information beyond a causal representation that retains the same four fifteen-minute endpoint changes when every other model and portfolio choice is held fixed?
not_authorized: calling any reused quarter chronologically prospective out of sample
opening or reading any raw archive month after 2025-06
evaluating the still outcome-unopened August 2025 to June 2026 interval
claiming HFT attainability from a fixed transaction-cost assumption

data.venue: Binance USD-M Futures public monthly archive
data.archive_access_rule: construct each allowed path explicitly; never scan the raw archive tree
data.manifest_availability_rule: open only rows declared available_verified; materialize only manifest-declared missing_remote_404 months as all-missing; reject every undeclared missing or corrupt archive
data.universe: the unchanged static Top-24 and 276 oriented pairs frozen in the parent raw-4h contract

native_1m.rule: the previous complete hour's sixty pair-residual one-minute increments in chronological order, formed with the pair weight in force at the start of that completed hour

causal_15m_control.rule: within each of the four consecutive fifteen-minute blocks, replace all increments by the block sum divided by fifteen
causal_15m_control.destroyed: within-block path variation, including ordering and dispersion

target.definition: at decision timestamp t, exact fixed-quantity pair cashflow from open t to next open t+1 (or the source terminal close), under w[t], excluding carried funding[t] and including next-boundary funding[t+1] on the grown fixed quantity
target.feature_information_cutoff: the within-hour path is [t-1h,t) under w[t-1], the 168 endpoint episodes are strictly before t and use their episode-start weights w[s], and current w[t] is a common-tail feature
target.availability_separation: feature_available[t] uses only prior paths/history and current decision availability; only label_mask intersects future pair_target_available[t]

economic_input_artifact.component_adapter: exact values and mask from the content-addressed evaluator artifact; no rebuild and no compatibility fallback
required_identity_tests: ordinary interval without a funding event
multi-period changing-action ledger path with terminal zero-target row

candidate_budget.fit_count_formula: 6 folds * (1 shared ridge + 2 representations * 2 neural architectures * 3 fixed seeds) = 78
candidate_budget.engineering_benchmark: one separately declared and discarded 2023Q2/native_1m/iTransformer/seed-1701 fit; excluded from all forecasts, ICs, portfolio results and the 78 scientific fits

endpoint_ridge.features: the common 168-hour endpoint history, pair weights and time coordinates only

common_training.seed_aggregation: arithmetic mean of all three predictions; never select a seed
common_training.loss: masked Smooth-L1 next-hour cashflow forecast loss
common_training.reason_cost_not_in_training: the existing audited infrastructure safely supports a forecast objective; costs and turnover are imposed in the identical downstream ledger so representation is the only experimental change

portfolio.mapping: fixed parent rank_pair_targets after the three-seed prediction mean

primary_comparison.portfolio_metric: paired daily net return and annualized Sharpe at 0.5 bp
promotion_gates: native-minus-control mean IC is positive in at least four of six folds
the one-sided 90% moving-block-bootstrap lower bound of the paired daily net-return difference is above zero
native 0.5 bp Sharpe exceeds control by at least 0.15
native Sharpe is positive at 1.5 bp and linearized break-even cost is at least 1.5 bp
the result is not driven by one quarter or one coin
primary_comparison.supporting_comparison: the identically specified LSTM contrast is reported but cannot replace the primary iTransformer contrast

required_outputs.stage_boundary: this package emits fixed pair targets; only the existing audited multicoin pair ledger may produce the portfolio-stage files

integrity.source_binding: contract, core, models, runner, frozen parent model and frozen parent contract are content-hashed; the three local source hashes are also explicit in every forecast identity
integrity.runtime_binding: Python, NumPy, pandas, Torch/CUDA, device/GPU and deterministic-runtime settings are canonically hashed in every forecast identity
integrity.resume_rule: an existing forecast is accepted only after exact identity, axis, finite-mask and governed target-rebuild validation; stale or swapped artifacts hard-fail
integrity.immutability: v2 components, summaries and completion manifests are create-only

stopping_rule.after_failure: record the failure; any new family requires a new append-only candidate entry and remains exploratory
stopping_rule.confirmation: requires a separately frozen contract and explicit user authorization
